name: School Calendars
description: Decisions by school districts and states that change the school year: first and last days, winter and spring break dates, added or removed teacher work days, snow day make-up rules and moves to four-day weeks. It also covers test and admission dates students plan around: SAT, ACT, AP, PSAT, LSAT and MCAT dates, college application deadlines and FAFSA. Each story names the district, testing agency or college, the vote or notice behind the change and the dates that move. It links to the printable school-year calendar and the classroom calendar guide so parents and teachers can mark the new dates. Rumors and unconfirmed social media posts are not reported until the district publishes them.
